title: English's Significance: Exam Performance by Subject and Future Income in China
Green Regulation, Trade Friendliness, and Local Policy Adaptation
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper examines the impacts of national policies on local policy formulation by studying the interplay between a top-down environmental regulation and the local Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) policies. We compiled a database of prefecture-level FDI policies in China spanning four decades and leveraged the Two Control Zones (TCZ) policy that designated some prefectures for pollution abatement. A diﬀerence-in-diﬀerences analysis shows that the TCZ designated cities formulated more friendly FDI policies after the TCZ policy. Mechanism analyses suggest that local governments loosen FDI regulations to offset economic costs of environmental regulation and attain political promotion.
abstract_zh: 本文通过研究自上而下的环境监管与地方外商直接投资（FDI）政策之间的相互作用，考察了国家政策对地方政策制定的影响。我们汇编了中国四十年间地级市层面的FDI政策数据库，并利用划定部分城市进行污染治理的两控区（TCZ）政策。双重差分分析表明，被划入TCZ的城市在该政策实施后制定了更为友好的FDI政策。机制分析表明，地方政府放松外资监管，以抵消环境监管带来的经济成本，并获得政治晋升。

title: Global Plastic Waste Reallocation and Pollution: Evidence from China's Import Ban
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper examines the global spillover effects of China's 2017 plastic waste import ban, which abruptly disrupted the world's largest destination for plastic waste. Using monthly bilateral trade data and satellite-based PM 2.5 pollution measures from 2015 to 2023, we implement a difference-indifferences strategy to estimate the ban's impact on international waste flows and air quality in recipient countries. Approximately 50% of displaced waste was redirected to other Asian countries. In comparison to unaffected waste categories, the affected categories experienced a surge in monthly net imports of $1.088 million USD per average receiving country. The largest increases occurred in countries with limited recycling capacity and weak environmental governance, particularly from non-OECD exporters and countries with stricter environmental regulations. Areas near waste processing sites in highimport regions experienced higher PM 2.5 concentrations, suggesting notable environmental and health costs. These findings underscore the unintended consequences of unilateral environmental regulation and the need for coordinated global waste management.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国2017年塑料废弃物进口禁令的全球溢出效应，该禁令突然中断了世界上最大的塑料废弃物目的地市场。利用2015至2023年的月度双边贸易数据和基于卫星的PM2.5污染测度，我们采用双重差分策略，估计该禁令对国际废弃物流动及接收国空气质量的影响。约50%被挤出的废弃物转向了其他亚洲国家。与未受影响的废弃物类别相比，受影响类别在每个平均接收国的月度净进口额增加了108.8万美元。增幅最大的国家是回收能力有限、环境治理薄弱的国家，尤其是来自非经合组织出口国以及环境监管较为严格的国家。在高进口地区，靠近废弃物处理场所的区域PM2.5浓度升高，表明存在显著的环境与健康成本。这些发现凸显了单边环境管制的非预期后果，以及开展协调一致的全球废弃物管理的必要性。

Regulatory Crowding Out under Capacity Constraints: Evidence from Multi-Task Environmental Enforcement
abstract: Governments regulate multiple activities, but enforcement capacity is limited. This paper examines how demand in one regulatory domain crowds out enforcement in others. We use seasonal enforcement of agricultural open burning in China as an exogenous demand shock, leveraging county variation in crop maturity and planting patterns. Using administrative penalty records, we show that environmental inspectors reallocate attention away from industrial facilities during harvest windows, causing a 30% decline in industrial environmental penalties and a 6.3% increase in pollutant emissions at peak harvest. Effects are larger where regulatory capacity is tighter. Surveillance technology that lowers monitoring costs mitigates these distortions.
abstract_zh: 政府监管多种活动，但执法能力有限。本文考察一个监管领域的需求如何挤占其他领域的执法资源。我们利用中国农作物秸秆露天焚烧的季节性执法作为外生需求冲击，借助县域间作物成熟期和种植模式的差异进行识别。利用行政处罚记录，我们发现环境检查人员在收割期间将注意力从工业设施上转移，导致收割高峰期工业环境处罚下降30%，污染物排放上升6.3%。当监管能力较紧张时，上述效应更为显著。能够降低监测成本的监控技术可以缓解这些扭曲。

title: Size Matters: Differential Response of Industrial Electricity Consumption to Temperature Variations Across Firms
The Impacts of Board's Unexpected Flood Experiences on Corporate ESG Performance
abstract: This paper investigates how board members' unexpected flood experiences affect their firm's Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) performance. Using anonymized individual-level travel data from China during 2017-2022, we identify flood experiences of publicly listed companies' boards. Employing a staggered Difference-inDifferences design, we find that the firm's ESG rating increases by 2.43% (4.03%) eight quarters after the board's flood experiences during business (personal) trips. The effect is more pronounced when the floods are more severe and when the affected board member holds higher ownership stakes. We rule out alternative explanations such as disaster relief efforts. Beyond improved ESG ratings, we document greater managerial attention to environmental issues, as reflected in corporate disclosures, and a rise in firms' environmental performance projects. In addition, we provide evidence on the underlying value mechanism by showing that the ESG improvements are correlated with the costs and benefits of ESG improvements and the business exposure to flood risks. We also provide evidence on values mechanisms by showing that the ESG improvements are correlated with inherent personal characteristics such as gender.
abstract_zh: 本文考察董事会成员意外的洪灾经历如何影响其所在企业的环境、社会和治理（ESG）绩效。利用2017–2022年中国匿名的个人层面出行数据，我们识别出上市公司董事会成员的洪灾经历。采用交错双重差分设计，我们发现，董事会成员在公务出行（个人出行）中经历洪灾后的第八个季度，公司ESG评级分别上升2.43%（4.03%）。当洪灾越严重、受影响董事的持股比例越高时，该效应越为显著。我们排除了灾害救援等替代性解释。除ESG评级提升之外，我们还发现企业披露信息中体现出管理层对环境问题的关注度提高，以及企业环境绩效项目的增加。此外，我们通过表明ESG改善与ESG改进的成本收益以及企业面临的洪水风险暴露相关，为其背后的价值机制提供了证据。我们还通过表明ESG改善与性别等内在个人特征相关，为价值观机制提供了证据。

title: Leader Networks and Interjurisdictional Contracting in Land Conversion Quotas
Pollution-induced Trips: Evidence from Flight and Train Bookings in China
abstract: Utilizing a novel database including nearly 2.2 billion booking records in China, we examine whether people escape from pollution by traveling to “cleaner” places. Combining an instrumental variable approach with high-dimensional fixed effects, we find a 50-unit increase in the AQI gap between a city pair leads to a 1.30% (1.33%) increase in train and airline ticket bookings from the origin to the destination city departing within one day (2-7 days). In addition, the destination of such pollution-induced trips is more likely to be an intra-province city with more tourist attractions. We also measure willingness to pay for clean air.
abstract_zh: 利用中国包含约22亿条订票记录的新颖数据库，我们考察人们是否通过前往“更清洁”的地方来逃避污染。结合工具变量方法与高维固定效应，我们发现，城市对之间AQI差距每增加50个单位，出发城市至目的城市、在一天内出发的火车票和航空票预订量增加1.30%（2–7天内出发的预订量增加1.33%）。此外，这类污染引致出行的目的地更可能是省内拥有更多旅游景点的城市。我们还测算了人们为清洁空气愿意支付的价格。

title: The Local Labor Market Effect of Relaxing Internal Migration Restrictions: Evidence from China
Disguised Pollution: Industrial Activities in the Dark
abstract: In this study we investigate disguised pollution by industrial firms in China. We find that sulfur dioxide (SO2) readings increase by 10.8% in air pollution monitoring stations four hours after sunset in high factory density areas, controlling for station-year, date, and city-hour fixed effects. Physical inspections by the Ministry of Environmental Protection may only temporarily reduce disguised pollution, suggesting that reliance on physical inspections to enforce regulations is ineffective if firms can shift production activities to non-daylight hours. We show that direct monitoring, as is done with some large polluters in China, can prevent this and should be cost-effective to extend to all industrial polluters.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察中国工业企业的隐蔽排污行为。我们发现，在工厂密集地区，日落后四小时空气污染监测站的二氧化硫（SO2）读数上升10.8%，该结果已控制站点-年份、日期和城市-小时固定效应。环境保护部的现场检查可能只能暂时减少隐蔽排污，这表明若企业能够将生产活动转移至非日间时段，依赖现场检查执法便是无效的。我们表明，中国对部分大型污染企业采取的直接监测可以防止此类行为，并且将其推广至所有工业污染者应当具有成本效益。

title: Expanding Footprints: The Impact of Passenger Transportation on Corporate Locations
Perceived Economic Prospects during the Early Stage of COVID-19 Breakout
The Effects of Policy Announcement, Prices and Subsidies on Water Consumption
abstract: With increasing water security challenges, water utilities around the world face complex decisions on water supply and demand management. This study investigates the effects of price and subsidy increases on water conservation in Singapore. Using anonymized monthly billing data on water consumption for 2.2 million residential accounts over 10 years, our difference-in-differences estimates show that the announcement of a two-phased 30% price increase reduces water consumption by 3.7% more for the public housing, relative to the private apartments. The announcement effect is larger than the implementation of price increase. Consumers with lower water usage respond more to the announcement of price hike while consumers with higher usage respond more to its implementation. An increase in utility subsidy reduces low-income households’ financial burden but does not affect water consumption possibly due to consumers’ low attentiveness to the subsidy change. The results suggest that the traditional market-based policy instruments, such as price and subsidy, could be combined with attention priming to achieve sustainable outcomes with minimal requirement on technology advancement and institutional innovation.
abstract_zh: 随着水安全挑战日益严峻，世界各地的供水公用事业机构在供水和需求管理方面面临复杂的决策。本研究考察了新加坡价格上涨和补贴增加对节水的影响。利用10年间220万个居民账户的匿名月度账单用水数据，我们的双重差分估计表明，分两阶段实施30%价格上涨的公告，使公共住房的用水量相对于私人公寓额外减少了3.7%。公告效应大于价格上涨的实际实施效应。用水量较低的消费者对涨价公告的反应更大，而用水量较高的消费者则对涨价的实际实施反应更大。公用事业补贴的增加减轻了低收入家庭的经济负担，但并未影响用水量，这可能是由于消费者对补贴变化的关注度较低。结果表明，价格和补贴等传统的市场化政策工具，可以与注意力引导相结合，以较低的技术进步和制度创新要求，实现可持续的结果。

title: Can Professional Football Players Adapt to Air Pollution? Evidence from China
abstract: In this paper, we study the impact of air pollution on Chinese professional football players’ performance. Our primary research question is whether the negative effects of air pollution can be mitigated by adaptation, and which cohort of players can have higher adaptability. We find that a higher pollution level during the game, relative to the adapted pollution level in players’ home cities, has a negative and significant impact on the players’ efforts and accuracy. The impact of non-adapted air pollution can be greatly offset by the home advantage, but not by personal attributes such as the higher ability.
abstract_zh: 本文研究空气污染对中国职业足球运动员表现的影响。我们的核心研究问题是：空气污染的负面效应能否通过适应加以缓解，以及哪类球员具有更强的适应能力。我们发现，相对于球员家乡城市所适应的污染水平，比赛期间较高的污染水平会对球员的努力程度与准确性产生显著的负面影响。未经适应的空气污染影响可以在很大程度上被主场优势抵消，但个人属性（如更高的能力）则无法做到这一点。

title: Gene, Economic Preference and Behaviors
Water Conservation through Plumbing and Nudging
abstract: In this paper, we investigate two solutions to urban water security challenges: plumbing and nudging. Using anonymized monthly billing data from 1.5 million accounts in Singapore over ten years, our staggered difference-in-differences estimates show that a nationwide Home Improvement Programme that improves the efficiency of plumbing reduces residential water consumption by 3.5%. This effect persists over a decade and is robust across population subgroups. Efficiency improvements could enhance the efficacy of other conservation polices and mitigate the effects of excessive heat, rainfall and air pollution. The savings from efficiency improvements on utility bills are small, but the increase in housing value exceeds the private cost of the Home Improvement Programme. However, an evaluation of a nationwide peer-comparison nudging programme finds no evidence of reduced water consumption. Overall, we show that plumbing improvements generate long-lasting effects on water conservation.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了应对城市水安全挑战的两种方案：管道改造与助推（nudging）。利用新加坡150万个账户十年间的匿名月度账单数据，我们的交错双重差分估计表明，一项全国性的家居改善计划（Home Improvement Programme）通过提高管道效率，使居民用水量减少了3.5%。这一效应持续十年以上，并且在各人口子群体中均保持稳健。效率提升可能增强其他节水政策的效果，并缓解高温、降雨和空气污染的影响。效率提升带来的水费节省很小，但住房价值的增加超过了家居改善计划的私人成本。然而，对一项全国性的同伴比较助推计划的评估发现，并无证据表明其减少了用水量。总体而言，我们表明，管道改善能够在节水方面产生持久的效果。

title: What Drives Health-care Spending in China? A Nationwide Decomposition Analysis
Assessment of Online Food Ordering and Delivery in Singapore During the COVID-19 Pandemic
Does foreign technology transfer spur domestic innovation? Evidence from the high-speed rail sector in China
Impact of High-Speed Rail on Road Traffic and Greenhouse Gas Emissions
abstract: Carbon emission reduction in the transportation sector is essential in the global mitigation effort and a large-scale public transport system has the potential to be an effective instrument. High speed rail (HSR) is one such example, yet it is unclear how much reduction in road traffic results from new rail routes. Using the difference-in-differences (DID) method, we show that new HSR routes in China leads to a 20.5 log-point reduction in the number of passenger vehicles and a 15.7 log-point reduction in freight vehicles running on parallel highways. These reductions were not seen on ordinary national roads. These effects translate into an annual reduction of 14.76 million tons of CO2 equivalent of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, or 1.75% of GHG emissions in China’s transport sector. This mitigation effect mainly comes from the substitution of highway goods transport with the conventional railway, instead of the direct replacement of highway passenger transport with HSR. The environmental benefit of HSR in China has not been fully realized because of the thermal-dominated electricity supply. Our further projections suggest that in greener electricity conditions, the HSR in China can significantly contribute more to the reduction in GHG emissions from the transport sector.
abstract_zh: 交通运输部门的碳减排对全球减缓气候变化至关重要，大规模公共交通系统有可能成为有效手段。高速铁路（HSR）即是一例，但新铁路线究竟能在多大程度上减少道路交通，尚不明确。采用双重差分（DID）方法，我们发现中国新开通的高铁线路使平行高速公路上的客运车辆数减少20.5个对数点，货运车辆数减少15.7个对数点。普通国道上未出现这些下降。这些效应相当于每年减少1,476万吨二氧化碳当量的温室气体（GHG）排放，占中国交通部门温室气体排放的1.75%。这一减排效应主要来自公路货运向传统铁路的转移，而非高铁对公路客运的直接替代。由于中国电力供应以火电为主，高铁的环境效益尚未得到充分实现。我们的进一步预测表明，在电力结构更加清洁的情况下，中国高铁可以为交通部门温室气体减排作出显著更大的贡献。

title: Impact of Temperature on Morbidity: New Evidence from China
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper investigates the relationship between temperature and hospitalization in China. Using inpatient visit claims of two major public insurance schemes covering 47 cities in 28 provinces for three years, we see a 7.3% increase in hospital admissions on days on which the average temperature is above 27°C, and a 2% cumulative increase of the mean 31-day visit rate of the benchmark-temperature day in hospitalization in the subsequent weeks. Such an effect is much larger than evidence from developed economies. Using detailed information on medical bills, we calculate that an additional hot day nationwide is associated with approximately 2 billion yuan (roughly equivalent to 0.3 billion US dollars) increase in medical expenses that are related to inpatient services, 1.9 billion yuan (roughly equivalent to 0.29 billion US dollars) of which is borne by the public insurance system, and 0.2 billion yuan (roughly equivalent to 0.01 billion US dollars) of which is borne by the insured.
abstract_zh: 本文考察中国气温与住院之间的关系。利用覆盖28个省47个城市、为期三年的两大公共医保计划住院就诊理赔数据，我们发现，当日平均气温高于27°C时，住院人次增加7.3%；在随后数周内，基准气温日之后31天的平均就诊率累计增加2%。这一效应远大于发达经济体的证据。利用详细的医疗账单信息，我们测算出全国每增加一个高温日，与住院服务相关的医疗费用约增加20亿元（约合3亿美元），其中19亿元（约合2.9亿美元）由公共医保体系承担，2亿元（约合0.01亿美元）由参保人承担。
